detail_observations.label: What they say
detail_observations.text:
Celinal looks up at you, smiling deceptively, "Welcome to Dallerjuba. You have probably never been to our village, though we lie only a few paces from the gates of Tanvu, our former city."

"Many of us lived in Tanvu before the emperor decided to..." Celinal pauses in an uncomfortable silence, "take up residence in our small town."

Celinal continues, "Do not be alarmed though, Master Kanjaro has been expecting you, please find him in the center of town at our shrine to Jin."

pages.article_html:
Redemption

Level 2 · Adventuring · Tanvu · Kojan

You awake to find yourself on the beach of a small village not far from Tanvu. Celinal, the mysterious woman whose greeting wakes you, claims a 'Master Kanjaro', located at a shrine in the center of this insignificant village, has been expecting you.

Objectives

Speak to Old Man Kanjaro

Description

1) Speak to Celinal in Dellerjuba Village in Tanvu. 2) Speak to Old Man Kanjaru in Tanvu.

What they say

On offering it

Celinal looks up at you, smiling deceptively, "Welcome to Dallerjuba. You have probably never been to our village, though we lie only a few paces from the gates of Tanvu, our former city." "Many of us lived in Tanvu before the emperor decided to..." Celinal pauses in an uncomfortable silence, "take up residence in our small town." Celinal continues, "Do not be alarmed though, Master Kanjaro has been expecting you, please find him in the center of town at our shrine to Jin."

Recorded by vanguard.fandom.com.

While you carry it

Celinal
The old man, looking as if any second he will kneel over and perish, stares blankly at you.

Recorded by vanguard.fandom.com.

On finishing it

Old Man Kanjaro You
Finally, the old man speaks, "Your blood-stained armor and weapons have been washed clean, but you still reek a foul stench." "I fear the tarnishes of death may have seeped through your armor, tainting something more more difficult to cleanse. The old man shakes his head in disgust. "But perhaps time will prove me wrong."

Recorded by fandom page.

Per the Forgotten Horde wiki's Tanvu page (Dallerjuba Village), 2007-2008 (http://web.archive.org/web/20080723045202/http://targonor.net/vg/pmwiki.php?n=Main.Tanvu).

findings.observation: Redemption shows level 2, starter Celinal, Hand in to Old Man Kanjaro, Previous Master Fhungusu and Next A New Master. The article preserves five attributed disagreements: ends npc (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80), ends npc (quest steps), level (wiki.silkyvenom.com:80), level (the Forgotten Horde wiki), next quest (silkyvenom). Disagreement labels do not provide alternative field values.

The objective says Speak to Old Man Kanjaro; description says Speak to Celinal in Dellerjuba Village and Speak to Old Man Kanjaru in Tanvu. The alternate fandom account is narrative about Master Kanjaro at the shrine. Spelling variants and narrative do not establish distinct or canonical identities.

Offering dialogue is attributed to Celinal. The carrying section displays Celinal followed by narration about the old man; this ambiguous attribution is preserved verbatim. Finishing section displays Old Man Kanjaro and You before old-man speech. These displays do not resolve the recorded ends-npc disagreements.

Both cached pages display location -45985, -41800, 283 and separately map spot 2 in Dallerjuba Village, Tanvu at -43081, -43260. These distinct coordinate contexts remain separate, without treating either as a verified spawn. Celinal displays level 10, Kojani, General NPC and 5 dots; quest level 2 is not a conflicting NPC level.

Celinal links Redemption as a given quest and associates Dawn Charm with quest completion, explicitly not a death drop. Redemption also displays Dawn Charm as a reward. Shared archive transcriptions and repeated tooltips are not independent historical corroboration. No loot recorded does not prove no loot existed.

Redemption displays Coin reward 15 without denomination. The article attributes dialogue to Fandom, notes to Forgotten Horde and links an emulator MMODB archive page. These original pages were not fetched in this review. Teleport/beach continuity with Master Fhungusu remains an attributed narrative, not verified transport mechanics.
